context: Tests whether the agent classifies a Python-runtime Debian-major bump as requires-migration and cites at least one of the rubric's specific indicators (system Python major shift / OpenSSL major / glibc symbol jump).

checklist.name: Classification is requires-migration
checklist.description: advice.md classifies the bump as requires-migration (not safe-mechanical).

checklist.name: Cites system Python major shift OR OpenSSL major bump
checklist.description: Indicators section explicitly names at least one of: 'System Python major shift' (bullseye's system Python 3.9 → bookworm's 3.11) OR 'OpenSSL major bump' (Debian 11 ships OpenSSL 1.1; Debian 12+ ships 3.x). Verbatim or clearly equivalent wording.

checklist.name: Identifies the binary-wheel risk
checklist.description: The advice connects the rubric's indicator to the input's specifics: binary wheels (cryptography / numpy / psycopg2) link against system libs and may need rebuilding.

checklist.name: Recommended action says do not apply mechanically
checklist.description: Recommended action says, in effect, 'do not apply mechanically' or 'human review required' or 'rebuild wheels and verify before rolling out'.

checklist.name: No fabricated CVE references
checklist.description: The advice does NOT cite specific CVE identifiers.
